Package com.smartlostfound.storage

Interface UserStorageService

All Known Implementing Classes:
CsvUserStorageService
public interface UserStorageService
Persistence service interface for user and administrator accounts. Enables decoupling storage formats (CSV, Database, etc.) from authentication logic.
